data.one_liner: Create and manage multiple windows and communicate between them in Flutter desktop apps.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter desktop apps to create, resize, reposition, and manage multiple windows, while also supporting inter-window communication and event listening.
use_when: You are building a desktop application with Flutter that requires multiple windows.
You need communication between different windows in a desktop app.
avoid_when: You need to support Linux desktop apps (Linux is not currently supported).
You are targeting mobile or web platforms exclusively.
strengths: Enables multi-window support for macOS and Windows.
Provides inter-window communication and window event listeners.
weaknesses: Requires manual platform-specific code modifications in Swift and C++.
data.setup_notes: Requires modifications to native macOS Swift files (MainFlutterWindow.swift, AppDelegate.swift) and Windows C++ files (main.cpp) as documented in the setup guide.
